description: Extract the main colours of an image with their share of the picture: k-means (default, deterministic) or median cut, 1-16 colours, sorted by share. Transparent pixels are ignored. Returns hex + rgb + % per colour, CSS custom properties (:root { --color-1 … }) or JSON, and optionally writes the website's swatch strip as palette.png. Same algorithm and sampling as the website, so the colours match. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/palette-from-image/

image.description: The image: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

output.description: Where to write palette.png (file path or folder ending in "/"). Implies swatchPng.

swatchPng.description: Also write palette.png (160×200 swatch per colour with its hex code).

name: image_palette
title: Colour palette from image
